# We’re currently hosting open playtests! Join our Discord at [https://discord.gg/eU6zxp8agn] to participate, get free rewards and a unique role ⚔️

Start with nothing but a shovel. End as a legend. Dig up rare keys, plunder chests full of loot and slay giant monsters with your friends!

⛏️ **Look for keys** - Explore mysterious islands, fight monsters guarding digging sites and dig up enchanted keys.
